SELECT p.name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_units
FROM products AS p
JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
GROUP BY p.id, p.name
ORDER BY total_units DESC, p.name ASC
LIMIT 4;

SELECT
    p.name AS product_name,
    p.price_minor / 100.0 AS list_price,
    MIN(oi.unit_price_minor) / 100.0 AS lowest_price_paid
FROM products AS p
LEFT JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.product_id = p.id
WHERE p.category COLLATE NOCASE = 'kitchen'
GROUP BY p.id, p.name, p.price_minor;

SELECT

    COUNT(*) AS refund_count,

FROM refunds

SELECT COUNT(*)
FROM refunds AS r
JOIN orders AS o ON o.id = r.order_id
JOIN customers AS c ON c.id = o.customer_id

SELECT

    COUNT(CASE WHEN o.status = 'cancelled' THEN 1 END) AS cancelled_orders
FROM orders AS o

WITH category_revenue AS (
    SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at) AS month,
           p.category,
           SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price_minor) AS revenue_minor
    FROM orders AS o
    JOIN order_items AS oi ON oi.order_id = o.id
    JOIN products AS p ON p.id = oi.product_id
    WHERE o.status <> 'cancelled'
    GROUP BY strftime('%Y-%m', o.placed_at), p.category
),
ranked AS (
    SELECT month,
           category,
           revenue_minor,
           RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY month ORDER BY revenue_minor DESC) AS revenue_rank
    FROM category_revenue
)

FROM ranked
WHERE revenue_rank = 1
ORDER BY month, category;
